title: Grounding-Source Comparison Exhibit v2: blinded re-registration after the v1 coverage-ceiling abort

supersedes.reason: v1 run aborted 2026-11-21 for a coverage ceiling (llms.txt lists reading-chain sequences verbatim; okf-bundle lacks readingChains entirely); per the v1 seal.json pilot_gate rule the only sanctioned responses were proceed or STOP-and-re-register, and this is the latter

llms-txt.source: frozen snapshot: freeze/llms.txt (sha256 pinned in frozen_payloads)

kg-json.payload: the FULL frozen snapshot text from freeze/knowledge-graph.json (no cluster slice)
kg-json.source: frozen snapshot: freeze/knowledge-graph.json (sha256 pinned below); live origin https://clouatre.ca/knowledge-graph.json at freeze time only

okf-bundle.payload: the FULL frozen OKF bundle text: freeze/okf/index.md plus every cluster index and concept page under freeze/okf/clusters/ (33 markdown files); sha256 pinned per file in frozen_payloads, no live fetch
okf-bundle.source: frozen snapshot: the freeze/okf/ tree (sha256 pinned per file in frozen_payloads); live origin https://clouatre.ca/okf/ at freeze time only

dataset.name: discriminative question families derived from the frozen knowledge-graph.json snapshot
dataset.corpus: finite-corpus evaluation of clouatre.ca (27 nodes: 24 posts + 3 pages, 91 citation edges)
dataset.variance_frame: item-sampling variance, not decoding variance (temperature 0); the only randomness is the deterministic question-sampling seed

families.F1: citation edges: for a post with >=1 outbound citation edge, list the linked post slugs (edge list in snapshot document order)
families.F2: edgeStats: inbound and outbound link counts for a post
families.F3: node.concepts: the concept slugs associated with a post (3-4 slugs)
families.F4: cluster membership: which cluster(s) a post belongs to (ground truth: the set of cluster identifiers whose clusters[].posts array contains the slug, in snapshot cluster document order; all 24 posts are eligible)

dataset.composite_ceiling_note: Under the 74-item composite with correct abstention = 1, llms-txt has 58 abstention items (F1+F2+F3) and 16 extraction items (F4); kg-json has 74 extraction items (F1-F4). Both arms face the same 74/74 theoretical ceiling. The composite must NOT be read as pure extraction performance. Conditional extraction accuracy denominators: llms-txt = F4 only (16); okf-bundle = F3+F4 (34); kg-json = F1-F4 (74). Conditional abstention accuracy denominators: llms-txt = F1+F2+F3 (58); okf-bundle = F1+F2 (40); kg-json = none (0).

ground_truth.blinding: ground-truth.json is committed BLINDED: only the sha256 of the full questions file appears in this seal; plaintext ground truth lands with the raw outputs post-run

question_sampling.sampling: all items sampled without replacement per family

pilot.held_out_semantics: the pilot is a separate held-out question set (its own seed and file, scored separately); it is never merged into the full-run file or the full-run scoring. Note: with a 24-post finite corpus, slug-level disjointness between pilot and full-run sets is impossible; the full run uses a fresh seed so the sampled question sets differ

full_run.composition: F1: 20 items from posts with >=1 outbound edge; F2: 20 items from edgeStats; F3: 18 items from node.concepts arrays (3-5 concept slugs; only 18 posts in the frozen snapshot have >=3 concepts, so 20 without replacement is impossible); F4: 16 items sampled from all 24 posts without replacement (snapshot document order as tiebreak); FRESH seed

primary_item_score.rule: answerable item + correct answer = 1; answerable item + false abstention (null) = 0; unanswerable item + correct abstention (null) = 1; any non-null attempt on an unanswerable item = 0
primary_item_score.answerability_map: F1 and F2 are answerable only by kg-json; F3 is answerable by kg-json and okf-bundle and NOT by llms-txt; F4 is answerable by ALL THREE arms (extraction, not abstention; kg-json has no abstention-credit items). Applied to all 74 items per arm
primary_item_score.cluster_label_rule: F4 ground truth is stored as cluster ids from snapshot clusters[]; the scorer accepts EITHER the cluster id or the cluster name, normalized (lowercased, whitespace-collapsed), using the canonical id->name mapping from the frozen snapshot (cluster id and name per clusters[] entry). Label usage per payload: freeze/llms.txt Concept Index lists clusters by id only ('- governance-oversight: ai-sdlc-governance-stack, ...'); freeze/okf/ uses both the human-readable name and the id (okf/index.md: '* [Agent Infrastructure](/clusters/agent-infrastructure/index.md)'; cluster index headings '# Agent Infrastructure' and 'Concepts in the agent-infrastructure cluster.'); freeze/knowledge-graph.json carries both the id and name fields per clusters[] entry. Hence the F4 prompt says 'cluster id or name'.

F1.primary_exact: set equality on deduplicated, normalized (lowercased, .json suffix stripped) slugs

F2.partial_credit: fraction of the two integers correct

F3.primary_exact: set equality on deduplicated normalized concept slugs

F4.primary_exact: set equality on normalized cluster labels (EITHER the cluster id or the cluster name accepted, lowercased and whitespace-collapsed, via the canonical id->name mapping from the frozen snapshot)

metrics.response_envelope: single top-level key answer for all families: {"answer": [...]} | {"answer": {"inbound": <int>, "outbound": <int>}} | {"answer": null}
metrics.abstention_instruction: present in every prompt (respond with {"answer": null} when the payload does not determine the answer)

statistics.primary_endpoint: overall exact match per arm; pairwise McNemar exact test (binomial two-sided on discordant pairs, paired items) with Holm-Bonferroni adjustment across the 3 arm pairs, alpha 0.05
statistics.secondary: paired permutation test on partial credit, 10000 permutations, seed 20261123
statistics.mdd_note: minimum detectable difference ~21-23pp aggregate at n=74, 80% power, alpha 0.05 (pairwise two-proportion); finite-corpus framing retained: item sampling draws from a fixed 24-post corpus, so the MDD bounds item-sampling variance only

pilot_gate.saturation: BLOCKING: okf-bundle <= 18/20 ONLY (llms-txt is EXEMPT from the saturation cap; kg-json is exempt; discrimination is read from the F3/F4 extraction spread)
pilot_gate.f3_competitiveness: BLOCKING: >= 2 arms with >= 2/5 on F3 items
pilot_gate.llms_txt_f4_guard: BLOCKING: llms-txt >= 2/5 on F4 items (extraction, not abstention)
